The fake now borrows the claimed row, validates its delivery kind, then parses/checks the sender, and only then removes/terminalizes or records it. The shared contract adds two focused scenarios to its existing runners: a misfiled sender-less claim stays running/untouched after refusal; an own-kind sender-less claim ends terminally and frees its successor. Both fake and SQLite call this same contract. This improves the proof surface without changing real-adapter runtime cost.
